sentence: This project looks for barriers to genetic testing in nephrology and builds and tests a point-of-care toolbox focused on genomic literacy.
This project uses genome editing and mouse modeling to study whether hundreds of cancer-associated mutations have gain-of-function properties, especially in pancreatic cancer.
This project studies and engineers principles of organ development to build functional human tissue models.
This project offers short-term cancer focused research experiences to improve understanding of the biology of cancer and cancer outcomes.
This project studies how losing maternal control of DNA replication affects genome duplication in the early mouse embryo.
This project combines single-cell genomics technologies to build a cell atlas of the developing mouse brain.
This project studies the mechanisms behind sarcopenic obesity in older adults and looks for ways to lessen it.
This project tests breast cancer biomarkers and builds clinical grade assays, combined with imaging data, to improve early detection of breast cancer.
This project develops methods to identify cancer recurrence using cancer registry data linked to health records.
This project studies how a transcription factor controls the metabolism and protective responses of human natural killer cells during viral infection.
This project designs and tests a device to help restore function in irreparable rotator cuff tears in the shoulder.
This project studies how targeting bile acid composition could treat obesity and obesity-related metabolic complications.
This project studies the effect of severe obesity on regional lung perfusion and vasoreactivity during acute hypoxemic respiratory failure.
This project tries to find out how brain development in primates works, in relation to fragile X syndrome and autism.
This project studies how a tumor cell surface ligand promotes lung adenocarcinoma development and immune evasion, and how it could be targeted in treatment.
This project tries to connect large amounts of molecular data on cancer types to the development of human cancer therapeutics.
This project studies how gene mutations lead to hematologic malignancies, using murine models.
This project builds an Artificial Intelligence Forest to collect behavioral and environmental data on non-human primates in their natural environment.
This project tests whether increased glucosylceramide drives kidney disease, mitochondrial dysfunction and inflammation in mouse models of obesity and diabetes.
This project provides data resources and analytical tools to link genetic, molecular and cellular traits to substance use disorder behaviors in rodent models.
